description: This file defines the Note immutable data model class, including constructors, copyWith, serialization, and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: An immutable class representing a note with id, title, body, creation and update timestamps. Includes methods for copying with modifications, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new Note instance with specified fields replaced.

methods.name: factory Note.blank
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a blank note with a given id and current timestamps.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Serializes the Note object into a map of primitive types.

methods.name: factory Note.fromMap
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a map of primitive values.
